title: Turkish I catalog record
description: One real, evidence-linked case where the Turkish letters I, ı, İ, i broke code or a user's expectation. One record = one YAML file under records/. The file name (without .yml) must equal `id`.

id.description: kebab-case: <language>-<operation or api>-<project>. Must equal the file name.

library.description: Project, library or tool where the case was seen. Use `stdlib` for the language runtime itself.

operation.description: What the code was trying to do when it broke.

kind.description: bug = the code violated the standard or its own intent and upstream fixed or confirmed it (e.g. Turkish locale rules applied to machine text, folding without normalization). by-design = the runtime correctly applies a Unicode default mapping; Turkish text needs a tailored call. expectation-gap = the code follows the standard but users expect search-style or Turkish-aware matching; a design decision, not a defect.

letters.description: Which of the four letters are involved.

locale_dependent.description: true = only happens when the process runs under a Turkish locale (tr_TR). false = happens everywhere, regardless of locale.

command.description: Copy-paste shell command(s) that show the bug. Prefer a one-liner against the language runtime; otherwise the smallest script.

environment.description: Runtime and version the command was run on, e.g. `Python 3.13.16, Linux`.

url.description: The issue, PR, commit or bug-tracker page that shows the case is real.

fix.description: What fixed it, or the correct approach for this layer (e.g. `Locale.ROOT`, `LC_ALL=C`, normalize then casefold, a `tr`-tailored call or collator). Say which Unicode layer the fix uses.

status.description: verified = someone ran `reproduction.command` and saw `actual`. unverified = taken from the upstream report only.

by.description: Who actually ran `reproduction.command`: a GitHub login, or a declared AI tool plus the person who vouches for the result, e.g. `claude-code (AI), reviewed by halilunay`.

references.description: Optional extra links: docs, Unicode SpecialCasing, related bugs.
